newsitem.title: USA: Hudson expects Q2 losses, seeks financing.
newsitem.headline: Hudson expects Q2 losses, seeks financing.

text.p: Hudson Technologies Inc said Thursday that it expects revenues and gross profits for the second quarter to be below its expectations, and sees "substantial losses" as a result for the three and six month periods ended June 30, 1997.

The company said it has funded its operations from working capital and its existing line of credit and currently does not have any significant availability under the credit line. It said it is seeking sources of financing to satisfy its capital needs, and that failure to obtain additional financing will have a material adverse effect on it.

The company attributed the decrease in revenues and gross profit, in part, to an unseasonably cool spring. In a statement, chief executive and president Kevin Zugibe said,"the unusually cool spring has had a negative impact on the company's ability to generate sales at gross profit levels which would sustain the profitability of the company."
Hudson provides refrigerant reclamation and management services.
Shares were down 3 to 5-7/8 in morning trading.
